verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Egypt: 📣
‘This month will mark the start of your calendar. It will be your first month of the year. 🗓️
‘Tell all Israel: On the tenth day of this month, each man must choose a lamb for his family—a lamb for each household. 🐑
‘If a household is too small to eat a whole lamb, share one with the nearest neighbor. Count people according to how much each person can eat. 🍽️
‘Choose a flawless year-old male lamb. It can come from the sheep or the goats. 🐑
‘Keep it until the fourteenth day of the month. Then, at twilight, the whole Israelite community must slaughter it. 🌆
‘Take some of its blood and brush it on the two doorposts and the top beam of each house where you eat. 🩸
‘That night, eat the meat roasted over fire, with unleavened bread and bitter herbs. 🍞
‘Don’t eat it raw or boiled in water. Roast it over fire—with its head, legs, and inner parts. 🔥
‘Don’t leave any of it until morning. If anything remains by morning, burn it up. 🔥
‘Eat like people ready to leave: belt fastened, sandals on, staff in hand. Eat quickly. This is Yahweh’s Passover. 🏃
‘That night I’ll pass through Egypt and strike every firstborn—people and animals. I’ll judge all Egypt’s gods. I am Yahweh. ⚖️
‘The blood on your houses will be your sign. When I see it, I’ll pass over you; no plague will destroy you when I strike Egypt. 🩸
‘Remember this day. Celebrate it as a feast to Yahweh, generation after generation. Keep it as a lasting rule. 📜
‘For seven days, eat unleavened bread. On day one, clear yeast out of your homes. Anyone who eats leavened bread from day one through day seven must be cut off from Israel. 🍞
‘Hold a sacred gathering on the first day and another on the seventh. Don’t do regular work on those days; only prepare the food each person needs to eat. 🙏
‘Keep the Festival of Unleavened Bread, because on this very day I brought your divisions out of Egypt. Keep this day through every generation as a lasting rule. 📜
‘Starting at sunset on the fourteenth day of the first month, eat unleavened bread until sunset on the twenty-first day. 🌙
‘For seven days, don’t let yeast be found in your homes. Anyone who eats leavened bread must be cut off from Israel’s community, whether foreign-born or native. 🚫
‘Eat nothing made with yeast. Wherever you live, eat unleavened bread.’ 🍞
Moses called Israel’s elders together and said, ‘Go choose lambs for your families and slaughter the Passover lamb. 🐑
‘Take a bunch of hyssop, dip it in the basin of blood, and brush the blood on the top beam and both doorposts. No one may leave the house until morning. 🩸
‘Yahweh will pass through to strike Egypt. When he sees blood on the top beam and doorposts, he’ll pass over the doorway and won’t let the destroyer enter your homes to strike you. 🛡️
‘Keep this as a lasting rule for you and your children. 📜
‘When you arrive in the land Yahweh promised to give you, continue this ceremony. 🗺️
‘When your children ask, “What does this ceremony mean?” 👧
‘Tell them: “It’s Yahweh’s Passover sacrifice. He passed over Israel’s homes in Egypt when he struck the Egyptians and spared our families.”’” The people bowed down and worshiped. 🙏
Then Israel’s people went and did exactly what Yahweh had commanded Moses and Aaron. ✅
At midnight, Yahweh struck every firstborn in Egypt—from Pharaoh’s firstborn son on the throne to the firstborn of the prisoner in the dungeon—and all the firstborn livestock. ⚠️
Pharaoh got up in the night, along with all his officials and all Egypt. A terrible cry went up, because there wasn’t one home without someone dead. 😢
During the night, Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron: ‘Get up! Leave my people—you and all the Israelites. Go worship Yahweh, just as you said! 📣
‘Take your flocks and herds too, just as you asked. Go—and bless me as well!’ 🐑
The Egyptians urgently pushed the people to leave the land fast. They said, ‘If you stay, we’re all going to die!’ 🏃
The people carried their dough before it could rise, with their kneading bowls wrapped in clothes and slung over their shoulders. 🎒
Israel’s people did what Moses had told them. They asked the Egyptians for silver and gold jewelry and clothing. 💛
Yahweh made the Egyptians look favorably on the people, so they gave them what they asked for. Israel carried off Egypt’s wealth. 🎁
Israel’s people traveled from Rameses to Succoth. About six hundred thousand men walked, not counting the children. 🧳
A mixed crowd went with them too, along with huge flocks and herds of livestock. 🐑
They baked unleavened cakes from the dough they had brought out of Egypt. They had been rushed out and couldn’t wait or prepare food for the journey. 🍞
Israel’s people had lived in Egypt for 430 years. ⏳
At the end of 430 years, on that very day, all Yahweh’s divisions marched out of Egypt. 🏃
That night is to be kept watch for Yahweh, because he brought them out of Egypt. All Israelites must keep watch on this night, generation after generation. 🌙
Yahweh told Moses and Aaron, ‘Here are the rules for Passover: no foreigner may eat it. 📜
‘Any male slave bought with money may eat it after he has been circumcised. ✂️
‘A foreign visitor or hired worker may not eat it. 🚫
‘Eat it in one house. Don’t carry any of the meat outside, and don’t break any of its bones. 🏠
‘The whole Israelite community must celebrate it. 🤝

‘If a foreign resident living among you wants to celebrate Passover to Yahweh, all his males must be circumcised. Then he may celebrate and be treated like someone born in the land. No uncircumcised person may eat it. ✂️
‘The same rule applies to anyone born in the land and to the foreign resident living among you.’ ⚖️
All Israel’s people did just what Yahweh had commanded Moses and Aaron. ✅
That very day, Yahweh brought Israel’s people out of Egypt, organized in their divisions. 🏃
